summary: Typed analyst sibling constrains separate essential/historical relations: explicit historical-to-essential inclusion plus accessibility excludes an infinite historical chain; an Option Nat witness without inclusion has nonempty accessible essential dependence on the same injective historical chain members. Old P∧Q source transcription, source claim, frozen Challenges and root no-regress premises retained. Rejected assuming a first in the series definition, conflating all historical links with essential links without a dictionary, and reading abstract compatibility as metaphysical possibility or permission for all accidental series. Here-and-now/removal and temporal applicability remain OPEN time/intervention bridges. Exact models, proof locators, prior-control scope and service/CLI comparison persisted in docs/causal-regress-and-grim-reapers.md. Follow-up sense-index investigation (2026-11-09, baseline 754bd9bfc2db475ae7fea2e4ea089b1413901ecc): the existing checked dictionary/model contrast is reusable unchanged but cannot bind the full historical/per-accidens sense. The missing step is an explicit temporal and post-generation intervention interpretation; universal versus selected-removal independence is unresolved. Preventing generation is not the same intervention as removing a predecessor after generation. SERIES_OF_CAUSES_2 must remain unbound; no allowance ID is removable on this evidence. The same definition is also used by FINITE_CAUSAL_HISTORY_AND_PER_SE_5, outside this slice. No proof inputs or root-premise truth status changed. The supplied checkout lacks .lake readiness; no cold compilation attempted. Existing proof evidence is reused, not newly verified. Owner subsequently authorized a narrower analyst sibling with selected post-generation removal responses and strict Nat generation-time precedence; see Historical selected-removal configuration. It does not replace the original sense. Comparison proves dictionary incompatibility under independence and loss, with a nonempty separated model and one omission model for each carrying constraint. No claim of infinite history or accessibility is added. Coordinator then supplied an independent warm build. Final focused build and preview accepted the new comparison after unfolding the finite-table predicates for decidability; no source or existing proof was changed. Preview evidence used session refinement-round at baseline 754bd9bfc2db475ae7fea2e4ea089b1413901ecc with the full combined scratch edit; final proof uses an explicit three-constructor carrier and constructive finite universal decision instance to avoid the propext/Quot.sound dependencies observed with generic Fin decisions. Disambiguation text was retained verbatim because changing it would invalidate the shared reviewed bundle; the sibling and binding boundary live in the owned definition and attempt. Final focused build, Comparator zero-axiom check and independent NanoDa kernel accept the new comparison result (listed in evidence). Computed frontier-diff reports no change (385 open root-reaching premises; 279 support alternatives). Owner-answer resumption at main c5506ac5f6d740ca465594b00f54b399e6e117f8: implemented all four response-scope reconstructions separately in PerAccidensResponses with new stipulative definition and statement siblings. Admissibility is a structural time/presence/operating-condition conjunction, not a free adequate-removal flag. Registered exercise-to-capacity strength arrows from explicit execution certificates and every-to-some arrows with Available on both ends. Controls use integer-dated no-first histories for both generation and instruments; all-exercise with nonempty removals; capacity without continued exercise; one exercise-surviving removal alongside a capacity-destroying admissible removal; and empty-domain universal vacuity. A distinct current-sustainer removal loses an operating condition and capacity while retaining the later member, and is excluded from admissibility. Rejected treating PR1289 Nat generation dates as the original, interpreting universal survival without availability as existential survival, and identifying the four siblings with the original sense by fiat. No original allowance removed. Full semantic parameters, limits and remaining original-identity/task/condition/intervention-applicability burdens persist in the owned original and new definitions. Exact essential-response-to-MovesAsMoved bridge and independent accessibility warrant remain OPEN; no source acquisition or attribution change.
